This is the maize plot where my family gets most of our food, so I must manage it with care even though it is small. I hope this year I will get the FISP coupon like last year — without the subsidy the fertilizer is too expensive for me. I will plant the hybrid seed I can get through the coupon together with my groundnuts between the maize rows, because the intercrop helps the soil and gives us relish. I cannot afford pesticides or to pay many workers; myself and my wife and children will do most of the work, and the rains from the sky are what I depend on.
